zh: 不要逐个枚举子串，而是固定右端点：考虑“以当前位置结尾的所有子串的不同字符数之和”在右端右移一格时如何变化。
把字符 c 放在位置 i 上时，只有起点在 c 上一次出现位置 j 之后的子串原来不含 c，它们的不同字符数各加 1；更早起点的子串已含 c，不变。所以这个结尾和增加 i−j。
last[c] 初始为 −1；tail 表示以当前位置结尾的子串的不同字符数之和；对每个位置 i：tail += i − last[c]，last[c]=i，answer += tail；最后输出 answer（用 64 位整数）。
en: Instead of enumerating substrings, fix the right end: look at how the sum of distinct counts over all substrings ending at the current position changes when the right end moves by one.

When character c is placed at position i, only substrings starting after the previous occurrence j of c lacked c before; each of them gains 1 distinct character, while earlier starts already contain c. So the ending sum grows by i - j.

Set last[c] = -1 initially; tail is the sum of distinct counts over substrings ending at the current position; for each position i: tail += i - last[c], last[c] = i, answer += tail; print answer (64-bit).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the sum of distinct-character counts over all substrings ending at the current position. If the new character last appeared at j, it adds i-j to that sum; add the sum to the answer at every step.

## Proof of correctness

When character c is appended, only the substrings whose start is after the previous occurrence of c did not contain c before, and there are exactly i-j of them; substrings with earlier starts already contain c and their counts do not change. Hence the ending sum is maintained correctly, and summing it over the different right ends covers every substring.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(26).
